Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.testing

Class DatabaseAssertions

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.testing.DatabaseAssertions
public final class DatabaseAssertions extends Object
Assertions on the rows of a database, in the style of Laravel's assertDatabaseHas.

The class has no JUnit dependency: a failed assertion throws AssertionError, which every test framework reports as a failure. Failure messages name the table and the compared columns and list up to three rows of the table, cut down to those columns and the id column; a column the test did not ask about is never printed.

The model assertions take a Model from the eloquent module. That module is a compile-time dependency of this one only: an application that calls just the table assertions needs no eloquent on its class path, because the JVM links the model code when a model assertion is first called, not when this class loads. Calling a model assertion without eloquent fails with NoClassDefFoundError. The model assertions never print the value of a column the model hides through ModelSerialization.getHidden().

Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads, as far as the query factory is.

    • assertHas

      public void assertHas(String table, Map<String,?> values)
      Asserts that a row with the given column values exists.
      Parameters:
      table - the table name, never null or blank
      values - the column values the row must have, never null or empty; a null value matches a null column
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the table name is blank or values is empty
      AssertionError - if no row matches; the message lists up to three rows of the table

    • assertMissing

      public void assertMissing(String table, Map<String,?> values)
      Asserts that no row has the given column values.
      Parameters:
      table - the table name, never null or blank
      values - the column values no row may have, never null or empty; a null value matches a null column
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the table name is blank or values is empty
      AssertionError - if a row matches; the message shows up to three matching rows

      public void assertModelExists(Model model)
      Asserts that the model's row exists, found by its table and primary key.
